record.title: Saint-Martin Sint Maarten spring 2020 cross-island restrictions
record.exceptions: Documented cross-border employment and urgent medically justified journeys; general shopping, family visits and leisure crossings prohibited.
record.imposing_authority: French prefecture coordinating with Sint Maarten government
record.enforcement: Policy or report as cited; uniform implementation at every crossing not presumed.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.uncertainty: Order issued March 29, with March 30 commencement explicitly reported at the joint press conference. Main French controls lifted at midnight June 1–2; containers remained at some roads. Dutch controls had ended May 17, so no uniform cross-island interval.
